subject: Scheduling: Beacon Health networking & IAM deep-dive — architecture review
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduling: Beacon Health networking & IAM deep-dive — architecture review

Hi Carlos —

Thanks again for your time on the demo last week. Per our conversation it sounds like a focused architecture session (networking, VPC peering/options, egress controls, and IAM for service-to-service access) will help unblock your security and infra teams.

Suggested attendees: Carlos (platform lead), Priya (procurement), Tim (security), plus our SE (Dev) and AE (me) — happy to expand.

Proposed 90-minute slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-10-19 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-10-20 09:00–10:30
- Thu 2026-10-21 14:00–15:30

Please reply with best times or send a calendar invite. Also, if you can share a high-level network diagram and any IAM policy constraints ahead of the call that will let Dev tailor the runbook.

Attachments: agenda-deep-dive-1020.docx (outline), redwood-vpc-checklist.xlsx (prep checklist)

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@beaconhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@beaconhealth.com>, Tim Cole <tim.cole@beaconhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Beacon Health networking & IAM deep-dive — architecture review

Stephanie —

Thanks, really appreciate the outline. Wed 10/20 09:00 PT works best for our team, but Priya asked to include procurement for contract/term Q&A and Tim wants to loop in a security engineer (he's out this week and suggested 10/20 but may need a slightly later slot).

Priya (procurement) is fine with 9:00 but asked if we could keep it to 75 minutes — are we able to shorten? Also, Tim — can you confirm whether 9:00 works for you or if we should target 10:30?

I'll attach our internal network diagram and a list of compliance controls — sending in a follow-up.

Best,
Carlos
Platform Lead, Beacon Health

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@beaconhealth.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@beaconhealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tim Cole <tim.cole@beaconhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Beacon Health networking & IAM deep-dive — architecture review

Thanks Carlos/Stephanie —

I can make 10/20 09:00 PT but prefer a 75-minute window for the core tech discussion + 10–15 minutes for procurement Q&A at the end. If you need a hard stop at 10:15 that's fine too.

Attaching internal purchase timeline and procurement POC in case that changes the ask.

(attachment: beacon-procurement-timeline.pdf, pdf)

—Priya
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Beacon Health

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Beacon Health networking & IAM deep-dive — architecture review

Stephanie/Marcus —

I can prepare for a 75-minute session; suggested agenda (high level):
1) 10 min intro & goals
2) 25 min network topology & VPC options (beacon diagram + proposed peering / transit)
3) 20 min egress controls & outbound data flow (NAT, proxies, private endpoints)
4) 15 min IAM patterns & service account mapping (redwood runtime vs customer systems)
5) 5–10 min procurement/next steps Q&A

Prep ask for Beacon: please share the network diagram (they said they'd send), subnet CIDR ranges, and any existing firewall egress rules or proxy configs. Also let me know if there are blocked ports for outbound traffic.

I'll bring a brief slide with recommended options and a one-page runbook for peer/routing config.

(attachment: beacon-network-diagram-v1.pdf)

—Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@beaconhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@beaconhealth.com>, Tim Cole <tim.cole@beaconhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Beacon Health networking & IAM deep-dive — architecture review

Stephanie/Dev —

Attached is the network diagram and a short memo on our current IAM guardrails. Tim confirmed he can attend 10/20 09:00 PT but prefers a strict 75-minute end if possible.

(attachment: beacon-network-diagram-v1.pdf, beacon-iam-constraints.docx)

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm the final timebox.

Regards,
Carlos

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@beaconhealth.com>, Tim Cole <tim.cole@beaconhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Beacon Health networking & IAM deep-dive — architecture review

Great — locking in Wed 2026-10-20 09:00–10:15 PT (75 minutes). I created the calendar event and included the agenda and the attachments Carlos shared. Invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-beacon-deep-dive

Checklist before the call:
- Beacon: confirm subnet/CIDR + any blocked outbound ports (Carlos) — received network-diagram-v1.pdf, noted.
- Beacon security: any required pre-call access or temporary allowlist for our SE IPs? If so please send the IPs (we can provide an allowlist range).
- Procurement: any SLAs/term constraints to review during the 10–15 minute Q&A (Priya)

If Tim needs to extend the session, we have Marcus (solutions architect) standing by and can schedule a follow-up deep dive for IAM policies.

Thanks everyone — see you Wednesday.

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123
